objective: Generate offline Python applications for Gaussian linewidth and Curie fitting. Fit integrated intensity against inverse absolute temperature to recover a Curie coefficient and background.
behavior: Use statistics.linear_regression with x=1/T and y=integrated intensity. Return coefficient_au_K, background_au, and rmse_au. No weighting. Include arrays predicted_au and residual_au in input row order (residual = measured minus predicted).
review: Assess model suitability, normalization, saturation and the comparability of integrated intensities across temperatures.
